## Musicly 1.1

**New: more than one Telegram channel.** Connect as many of your channels as you like — the same bot reads them all. Open your channel, tap the Telegram button at the top, and choose **Add another channel**. Each channel gets its own section on Home and its own page in Library, and all of them feed Your mix.

Updating from 1.0? Just install over it — your channel, songs and likes stay.

**Which file do I download?**
- **Musicly-1.1-arm64.apk** — almost every phone from the last 6+ years. Pick this one.
- **Musicly-1.1-older-phones.apk** — only if the first one says "App not installed".

**How to install**
1. Tap the APK below to download it.
2. Open it. If Android asks, allow "Install unknown apps" for your browser or Files app.
3. Tap Install.

**What's inside**
- Play full songs from your Telegram channels (guided setup — no tech skills needed), the music on your phone, and live radio from around the world
- Your mix, synced lyrics, playlists, artists and a hotlist
- Lock-screen and notification player, plus home-screen widgets
- Backups that survive reinstalling the app
